items.q: What is the « Meet Baby Daniel » gathering?
items.a: It is a warm, informal family gathering where we have the joy of introducing Baby Daniel to our relatives, friends, and loved ones over refreshments and conversation.

items.q: When and where will the ceremony take place?
items.a: The gathering will take place on Sunday, November 1, 2026 starting at 2:00 PM at Marie and Joseph’s home in Quartier Simbock, Yaoundé. You can open directions or add the event to your calendar in the 'Practical Info' section.

items.q: How do I confirm my attendance?
items.a: Simply fill out the RSVP form above and tap 'Continue on WhatsApp'. Your message will be prepared automatically—just press Send inside WhatsApp.

items.q: How can I share photos taken during the gathering?
items.a: After the ceremony, the parents will open the 'Share Photos' page protected by the family invitation code. Every photo is reviewed by the parents before appearing in the gallery.

items.q: Are the photos in the album public?
items.a: No. The album blocks search engine indexing, GPS metadata is stripped on upload, and only photos approved by the parents are displayed.

privacy.title: Family Album Privacy Notice
privacy.subtitle: Because these are Baby Daniel’s very first memories, this space has been crafted with special care for family privacy.

purpose.title: 1. A strictly family-oriented, caring space
purpose.body: This website and its photo album exist solely to share the invitation to Meet Baby Daniel and gather snapshots taken by our loved ones. No advertising trackers, commercial analytics, or facial recognition tools are used.

moderation.title: 2. Mandatory parent moderation prior to publication
moderation.body: No photo uploaded by a guest is ever published automatically. Every image is placed in a private holding queue for review by the parents. Only explicitly approved photos become visible in the gallery.

technical.title: 3. EXIF/GPS metadata removal & no search indexing
technical.body: When photos are processed by the server, EXIF metadata—including GPS location coordinates—is stripped. The private album includes directives instructing search engines not to index its pages. No child’s full last name is ever requested.

storage.title: 4. Private storage & retention period
storage.body: Files are stored in a private storage bucket and served exclusively via short-lived signed URLs. The parents configure the retention period (currently {{retentionDays}} days) and may permanently delete any photo and its associated files at any time.

limits.title: 5. Important note regarding images displayed on screen
limits.body: Although bulk downloading is disabled and access is restricted, any photograph displayed on a screen can technically be captured via screenshot or copied by an authorized viewer. We rely on the kindness of every relative and friend not to redistribute these family photos.
